summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing an underwriting and pricing agreement plus supplemental indenture for a $1,000,000,000 issuance of 5.908% senior callable fixed-to-fixed reset rate notes due 2032, settled October 16, 2026 through NatWest Markets Securities and a syndicate including Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, Mizuho, Morgan Stanley and TD Securities. This is a routine debt capital markets takedown under an existing F-3 shelf, not a special situation. No equity terms, premium, board recommendation or regulatory clock apply; the only watch item is the reset/call schedule and spread at the first reset date.
